discussion:
## Uninstall the nis package

The support for Yellowpages should not be installed unless it is required.

**Rationale:**

NIS is the historical SUN service for central account management, more and more replaced by LDAP.
NIS does not support efficiently security constraints, ACL, etc. and should not be used.

steps.name: Uninstall the nis package
steps.shell:
# CAUTION: This remediation script will remove nis
# from the system, and may remove any packages
# that depend on nis. Execute this
# remediation AFTER testing on a non-production
# system!


# check wether the package is virtual: if not, remove it.
# if the package is virtual, iterate on providers
#  if a provider is installed, remove it
is_virtual=`apt-cache showpkg "nis" | grep -Pzc 'Versions: \n\n'`
if [ $is_virtual = 1 ]; then
    rprovides_line=`apt-cache showpkg "nis" | grep -n 'Reverse Provides:' | cut -f1 -d:`
    pkglist=`apt-cache showpkg "nis" | tail -n +$(($rprovides_line + 1)) | cut -f1 -d' '`
    for package in $pkglist; do
        not_installed=`apt-cache policy $package | grep -c 'Installed: (none)'`
	if [ $not_installed = 0 ]; then
	    DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get -o DPkg::Lock::Timeout=60 remove -y $package
	fi
    done
else
    DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get -o DPkg::Lock::Timeout=60 remove -y "nis"
fi
